name: @smoke-monkey/canvas-desktop
description: Smoke Monkey Canvas Desktop — Cross-platform desktop workspace for visual multi-agent spatial development (macOS, Windows, Linux)

scripts.build:mac: npm run build:web && tauri build --bundles app,dmg
scripts.build:win: npm run build:web && tauri build --bundles nsis,msi
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:web && tauri build --bundles appimage,deb
